findings.current: Perhaps instinct was another name for foresight.
findings.defect: Changes intuition to instinct and renders 叡智, meaning wisdom, as foresight.
findings.rationale: The sentence equates 직감 with 예지(叡智), not an instinctive prediction of the future.
findings.replacement: Perhaps intuition was just another name for wisdom.
findings.source: 직감이라는 것은 어쩌면 예지(叡智)의 다른 이름일지도 모른다.

findings.current:
“I’m fine. I might’ve pissed myself a little, though.”

“What?”

“Just so you don’t get the wrong idea, I’m a big man in every way—but this time, I mean small.”
findings.defect: Makes Johnson’s euphemism explicit and leaves the punchline sounding as though he means a part of his body is small.
findings.rationale: 살짝 지린 것 같긴 하지만 is evasive, and 작은 refers back to how much he leaked; his claim that everything about him is big sets up that contrast.
findings.replacement:
“I’m fine. Though I might’ve had a little accident.”

“What?”

“Just so you don’t get the wrong idea, I’m big in every way. This time, though, it was only a little.”
findings.source:
“괜찮아. 살짝 지린 것 같긴 하지만.”

“네?”

“오해할 것 같아서 덧붙이자면, 나는 모든 게 큰 사람이지만 이번만큼은 작은 거야.”

findings.current: The two characters that formed the word *selflessness* didn’t apply only to martial arts.
findings.defect: “Selflessness” suggests altruism rather than losing awareness of oneself and passing time.
findings.rationale: The following sentence explains that Jin was so absorbed in his questions he failed to notice time passing.
findings.replacement: The two characters meaning *self-forgetfulness* didn’t apply only to martial arts.
findings.source: 무아(無我)라는 두 글자는 무공에만 적용되는 것이 아니다.

findings.current: At my call, Xiao Shen immediately understood what I meant. He drew his sword in a flash and plunged it deep into the ground beneath our feet.
findings.defect: Omits Jin stopping and changes the sword’s target from the ground beneath Xiao Shen’s feet to beneath the group’s feet.
findings.rationale: 발걸음을 멈춘 describes Jin stopping before the call; 발밑 refers to where Xiao Shen drives his sword.
findings.replacement: I stopped and called out. Xiao Shen immediately understood what I meant. He drew his sword in a flash and plunged it deep into the ground beneath his feet.
findings.source: 발걸음을 멈춘 내 부름에, 그 의미를 즉각 깨달은 샤오 쉔이 벼락처럼 뽑아 든 검을 발밑 깊숙이 찔러넣었다.

findings.current: The distance of more than twenty meters vanished in an instant.
findings.defect: Turns an approximate twenty meters into a distance exceeding twenty meters.
findings.rationale: 이십여 미터 gives an approximate distance.
findings.replacement: A distance of around twenty meters vanished in an instant.

findings.current: The title “The Prophet” was something the monster had announced to the world itself.
findings.defect: “The monster” could refer to the Ant Lion Jin is questioning rather than the figure who disclosed the title.
findings.rationale: 놈 refers to The Prophet here; the Ant Lion’s ignorance is why Jin realizes the question was mistaken.
findings.replacement: The Prophet had personally announced that title to the world.
findings.source: 선지자라는 명칭은 놈이 스스로 세상에 밝힌 것이다.

summary: Several meaningful shifts affect the opening idea, Jin’s absorption, and Johnson’s joke; a few action and quantity details also need correction.
